essence: Obeisance is directed to the deity Vaṭuka Bhairava in the heart.
The formula endowed with five short vowels should be placed in the positions beginning with īśāna.
The practitioner should form the limbs with class syllables and beginning with the praṇava.
One should constantly contemplate Vaṭuka holding a trident and a staff.
One should always meditate on the fear-removing god clothed in red like the bandhūka flower.
